title: Very nice baking sheet
text: Very nice baking sheet. This sheet is non-stick without the teflon coating.  I love that it doesn't need anything to stop items from sticking to it.  You can use a non-stick spray, but it does very well without it.  It heats evenly, cookies come out perfect.
